messages:
bob_customer: Hey team — our app started getting 400s from the /v1/rerank endpoint after a deploy. Response body: `{"error":"invalid_request","message":"items must be a non-empty array"}`. Happening for ~10% of requests.

alice_support: Thanks for the report — can you paste the exact request payload (no keys with secrets) and the request id / timestamp? Also which SDK or curl are you using?

bob_customer: Request id: req_20240317_01. Using curl + our Node SDK (internal wrapper). Payload we send is:```json
{
  "queries": ["what is the refund policy"],
  "candidates": ["doc1", "doc2"]
}```
We thought rerank would accept queries+candidates.

alice_support: Ah — that payload doesn't match the rerank spec. The API expects a top-level "items" array where each item is `{ id, query, candidates: [{ id, text }] }` or a similar shaped object. Sending top-level `queries` and `candidates` will trigger the validation that complains about missing/empty items. Also note we require candidates to be an array of objects (not strings).

carlos_eng: Another possibility: our telemetry shows some of your requests are double-encoding the body from the SDK — the wrapper serializes then the underlying client serializes again, turning arrays into strings which the server treats as malformed and empties. Can you grep for `JSON.stringify` calls around the HTTP client?

bob_customer: Oooh we do have `JSON.stringify(payload)` in both places. Reproduced locally: when I stringify twice the server sees `items` as a string and then validation drops it, returns the same 400. Example bad request body we sent after double-stringify:```json
"{\"items\":\"[]\"}"
```

dana_sre: That matches: server validation path checks `Array.isArray(items)` — string fails and becomes treated as empty. Fix is to avoid double stringify or set content-type and pass raw object to the HTTP client.

alice_support: For a quick repro/fix, try this working payload (curl):```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"items":[{"id":"q1","query":"refund policy","candidates":[{"id":"d1","text":"30-day refund"},{"id":"d2","text":"no refunds"}]}]}'
```

bob_customer: Tried that exact curl and it works — returning 200 and scores. Removing our extra stringify fixed the problem in staging.

carlos_eng: We'll add a small heuristic to the SDK wrapper to detect stringified bodies and warn in dev builds. Also adding a clearer error message server-side to indicate when `items` is present but not an array.

infra_bot: Deploy scheduled to add warning logs and one-line SDK change at 2024-03-20 03:00 UTC.

alice_support: Great — marking this as resolved for now. If you see any more 400s, please reopen with the request id and a raw curl repro. :thumbsup:

bob_customer: Thanks all! Saved our production traffic. :heart:
